operation_details.item: The user scheduled a company town hall for next Friday about the restructuring.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How is the restructuring work progressing today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The role-mapping review is complete, and we’re currently drafting the communication plan.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That’s a solid milestone. Are managers already working through how they’ll handle questions from their teams?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, managers are preparing their team Q&A notes now.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good. Have you set a broader forum to bring everyone up to speed?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I scheduled a company town hall for next Friday about the restructuring.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That should give the communication plan and manager notes a clear deadline. Will the town hall focus mainly on the changes and the rationale behind them?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, with enough time for people to ask questions after the overview.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only the scheduled restructuring town hall, while keeping the completed role-mapping, the comms plan, and the manager preparation.
